status: PROVISIONAL DOCUMENT-BASED TRIAGE ONLY; zero source-specific M36a native replays; NOT an achieved JEE coverage score
cohort_rule: Exactly the original 29 M21a source anchors in original order plus ONE official 2021 Paper 1 Q9-Q10 two-charge system counted as a single apparatus.

old_tiers_m20c_only.A: Existing qualified physics and suitable representation for the requested observables; authoring might still be manual
old_tiers_m20c_only.B: Partial existing physics; requires a small qualified reusable observer/authoring/view/analysis improvement for source-fidelity
old_tiers_m20c_only.C: Needs a genuinely new physical model relationship, qualified regime, or solver; partial theorems may still be true
old_tiers_m20c_only.D: Outside intended project regime or source too unclear to interpret

candidate_route_legend.supported_scoped: Documentation supports a qualified physics/observation route; NOT an M36a verified original-problem simulation.
candidate_route_legend.partial: Only a faithfully bounded subset or teacher-authored continuation is currently represented.
candidate_route_legend.unsupported: Requested local physics remains unqualified; explicit refusal is required.

cases.problem_family: uniform-field work
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Static uniform-field endpoint potential work; no particle path required.
cases.exclusions: A potential difference is not a timed trajectory.

cases.problem_family: far-separated wired spheres
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Leading self-capacitance connection of genuinely distant conductors with separate identities.
cases.exclusions: Not finite-separation induction, a concentric-shell substitute, or wire-current dynamics.

cases.problem_family: electron stopping near charged sheet
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: One-sided ideal metal-sheet field and numerical electron reversal under the source's idealized field.
cases.exclusions: No induced conductor response, microscopic contact, or fringe field.

cases.problem_family: wired solid sphere and shell released energy
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Mixed radial conductor backend supports field-energy before and after concentric connection.
cases.exclusions: Static release energy is not a current or heat-rate waveform.

cases.problem_family: grounded concentric conductors
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Grounded concentric conductors with specified metal regions and charges.
cases.exclusions: No nonconcentric irregular-conductor surface-density claim.

cases.problem_family: electron transit between voltage-biased plates
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: True uniform-gap electron transit and terminal ideal stop-surface event.
cases.exclusions: No self-consistent plate-induced dynamics or collision after the terminal event.

cases.problem_family: rigid dipole angle and energy
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Finite rigid-dipole static energy/orientation ranking in a uniform field.
cases.exclusions: Do not infer actual angular trajectory without inertia and initial angular state.

cases.problem_family: cavity charge and exterior potential
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Concentric cavity induced-charge and exterior static potential models.
cases.exclusions: Not time-resolved charge transfer or arbitrary displaced cavity geometry.

cases.problem_family: charge approaching grounded sphere
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Static induced charge/force snapshots near grounded sphere are qualified.
cases.exclusions: The requested induced-current time behavior needs a physical approach protocol and derivative of genuine conductor response; not solved by static position sweep.

cases.problem_family: neutral sphere tangent charge geometry
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Single neutral/isolated sphere with external point source and source-given geometry.
cases.exclusions: Static image charge model, not a moving conductor or dielectric.

cases.problem_family: stored field energy of concentric shells
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Concentric connected-shell radial field-energy ledger.
cases.exclusions: Do not omit outer radial field regions or assert transient release.

cases.problem_family: connected concentric shells and heat
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Concentric before/after connection and released electrostatic energy.
cases.exclusions: No circuit resistance or time-domain heating law.

cases.problem_family: irregular conductor with two nonconcentric cavities
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Gauss-law totals remain possible; local nonconcentric multicavity induced densities and fields are not certified.
cases.exclusions: Requires genuinely qualified 3D conductor-boundary treatment.

cases.problem_family: two charged rings and transverse applied E: axial work
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Source-given two-ring endpoint work with transverse applied field retained in force ledger.
cases.exclusions: No fictitious free axial path or numerical mass for symbolic follow-up.

cases.problem_family: mixed separated and concentric wired shells
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Separate concentric and far-separated conductor regimes are represented independently.
cases.exclusions: Arbitrary diagram rows mixing close separated and concentric connected shells need specific topology/physics admission; cannot conflate models.

cases.problem_family: wired concentric shells change potential
cases.source_provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam
cases.qualified_route: Concentric connected-shell before/after potentials under charge conservation.
cases.exclusions: No elapsed-time connection process.

cases.problem_family: proton starts between vertical plates: 45-degree acceleration
cases.source_provenance: IIT-JEE 2012 printed archive, externally corroborated
cases.qualified_route: Uniform prescribed electric field and genuine gravity jointly yield the initial 45-degree acceleration.
cases.exclusions: Ideal plate-gap field only; no proton-induced plate response or impacts.

cases.problem_family: oil-drop equilibrium after switched disc field
cases.source_provenance: JEE Advanced 2020 printed archive, official source not independently checked
cases.qualified_route: Actual equilibrium electron-count observable is addressed and a clearly teacher-specified switched-field/drag example exists.
cases.exclusions: Original problem supplies no drag constant, switch time or complete initial state, so no unique source-faithful transient can be claimed.

cases.problem_family: negative particle between two equal fixed point charges
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Reflection-certified fixed-point source inventory and real invariant-plane negative-charge motion.
cases.exclusions: No fake force projection; only actually symmetric source geometry passes.

cases.problem_family: uniform fixed charge ring on symmetry axis
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Full ideal fixed charged-ring field is now available in addition to earlier axial qualification.
cases.exclusions: Ring is nonresponding prescribed charge, not a metal conductor; wire singularities are guarded.

cases.problem_family: uniform volume charge potential and field
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Uniform volume-charge sphere field and actual particle motion in certified domain.
cases.exclusions: Insulating distributed volume charge is not a metal conductor.

cases.problem_family: conducting spherical shell radial V/E
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Radial field and potential of concentric conducting shell with surface boundaries.
cases.exclusions: Static radial observation, not time evolution.

cases.problem_family: charge inside two concentric shells
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Concentric shell and source analytical/FEMM-qualified geometry.
cases.exclusions: No off-centre general multicavity 3D claim.

cases.problem_family: outer shell net charge varied
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Distinct static radial equilibria for changed outer conductor net charge.
cases.exclusions: Electric field jump/surface and metal thickness remain physical.

cases.problem_family: external charge near grounded conducting sphere
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Kelvin image-charge induced force for charge near grounded sphere.
cases.exclusions: Static force/energy curve is not a freely moving charged body.

cases.problem_family: two very distant thin spheres joined by wire
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Leading far-separated linked-sphere approximation and conserved group charge.
cases.exclusions: No mutual polarization/finite-wire energy beyond admitted asymptotic order.

cases.problem_family: central versus displaced cavity point charge
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Exact Kelvin image model captures displaced cavity source's nonuniform inner induced density.
cases.exclusions: Only a supported spherical cavity, not an irregular multihole conductor.

cases.problem_family: irregular cavity or irregular conductor exterior
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Only Gauss-law total induced charges are presently justified.
cases.exclusions: Local surface-density and field map for arbitrary displaced/irregular cavities need new solver.

cases.problem_family: three nonconcentric cavities in one conductor
cases.source_provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
cases.qualified_route: Gauss-law totals can be explained, but exact multi-cavity local field/sigma is unsupported.
cases.exclusions: Do not render three irregular cavities as concentric shells.

cases.source: JEE Advanced 2021 Paper 1 English; archive apparatus also transcribed in 02_conductors_half_size.pdf
cases.problem_family: two unlike fixed charges: V=0 circle
cases.source_provenance: official JEE Advanced 2021 Paper 1; documented in M21b
cases.qualified_route: Two fixed charges -Q at x=0 and +Q/sqrt(3) at x=2 m admit an actual sampled V=0 circle with centre (3,0) and radius sqrt(3) m.
cases.exclusions: Teacher-selected Q=1 nC for visualization is not an original given; mask singularities and do not treat two questions as two distinct physical systems.
